name: How can I prevent future paint damage that would require touch-ups?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future paint damage that would require touch-ups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing paint damage extends the life of your paint job. Consider using furniture pads to avoid scuffs when moving items. Place door stoppers to prevent knobs from hitting walls. For high-traffic areas, or homes with children and pets, opting for durable, washable paints (like eggshell or satin finishes) can make cleaning easier and reduce the need for touch-ups. Regularly cleaning surfaces with a mild solution also helps maintain their appearance and prevents stain buildup that might otherwise require repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent damage by using furniture pads, door stoppers, and durable, washable paints in high-traffic areas. Regular cleaning also helps maintain appearance.
